requirements: R1: Patch existing status synchronization logic to correctly assign rootCausePatternId for PRs closed without merge.

slices.title: Patch defect categorization logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the defect categorization patch for this epic, I want to assign rootCausePatternId to uncategorized defect events, so that task status mismatches are properly tracked and reduced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task status mismatch defect event from an unmerged PR,
When the system evaluates the state,
Then a valid rootCausePatternId must be assigned to the defect event.
Given unit and integration tests executing this logic,
When the PR is closed without merge,
Then tests must verify the correct rootCausePatternId is saved.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of uncategorized status mismatch review concerns from 2.7% to 0%
